{{Short description|Norwegian chemist (1930–2009)}}
'''Marit Trætteberg''', née '''Krogstad''' (28 September 1930 – 27 October 2009) was a Norwegian chemist.

She was born in [[Ålesund]]. She graduated from the [[Norwegian Institute of Technology]] with the [[sivilingeniør|siv.ing.]] degree in 1954, and was hired as a lecturer in 1962. In 1969 she was promoted to [[docent]], and in 1970 she took the [[dr.philos.]] degree. She was promoted to professor in 1974. From 1992 to 1994 she was the prorector of the [[University of Trondheim]]. She died in October 2009 in [[Trondheim]].<ref name=snl>{{cite encyclopedia|year=|title=Marit Trætteberg|encyclopedia=[[Store norske leksikon]]|editor=|publisher=|location=Oslo|url=http://www.snl.no/Marit_Tr%C3%A6tteberg|language=Norwegian|accessdate=2 December 2009}}</ref>

She was a fellow of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]], the [[Royal Norwegian Society of Sciences and Letters]] and the [[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]]. She was a board member of [[NAVF]] from 1972 to 1978.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.dnva.no/c51131/artikkel/vis.html?tid=49857|language=Norwegian|accessdate=18 May 2012|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]]|title=Minnetale over professor Marit Trætteberg|author=Hagen, Kolbjørn|authorlink=Kolbjørn Hagen}}</ref>
